in_sanskrit.name: बर्खा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Barkha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vrksha', which means 'tree'. The monsoon clouds are likened to trees as they bring life-giving rain to the parched earth. The prefix 'bar' in Barkha means 'showering' or 'raining', making the name a fitting representation of the monsoon season in India.

in_hindi.name: बर्खा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Hindi name Barkha translates to 'bondage outside, experience outside'. This name is often used to describe a person who is free in their actions and thoughts, but is bound by circumstances or societal norms in their external life.

in_tamil.name: பர்கா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Barkha translates to 'rain-bringing woman, woman of monsoon'. This name is a beautiful tribute to the monsoon season, which is a time of renewal and rebirth in Indian culture.

in_telugu.name: బర్ఖా
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name Barkha translates to 'giver of rain, giver of life'. This name is a fitting tribute to the monsoon season, which is a time of renewal and growth in Indian agriculture and culture.

in_marathi.name: Barkha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Barkha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of rains and fertility. The name Barkha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Rain cloud’. The goddess of rains is associated with the monsoon season and is believed to bring prosperity and fertility.
